title: Chart Chaos at City Hall
subtitle: Pick the right chart to present the fraud report
conceptSummary: Right chart for right data: Bar for comparisons, Line for trends over time, Pie for proportions (max 5 slices), Scatter for correlation.

dialogue.text: The City Hall commissioner wants a fraud report. We have 4 data stories to tell. Help pick the right chart for each!
This is the art of data storytelling. The wrong chart makes people ignore the insight. The right one makes it undeniable.

teachMoment.title: Choosing the Right Chart
teachMoment.body:
Quick guide:
• Bar chart — compare categories (which city had most fraud?)
• Line chart — trends over time (did fraud increase?)
• Pie chart — proportions of a whole (% of fraud by payment type) — max 5-6 slices!
• Scatter plot — relationship between two numbers (does spend correlate with fraud?)
• Histogram — distribution (how are transaction amounts spread?)

task.instruction: For each scenario, pick the BEST chart type.

questions.scenario: Show fraud cases per city (Mumbai: 45, Delhi: 32, Hyderabad: 28)
questions.explanation: Bar chart is perfect for comparing values across categories (cities).

questions.scenario: Show how total fraud amount changed month-by-month over 2024
questions.explanation: Line chart shows trends over time clearly.

questions.scenario: Show the % breakdown of fraud by payment method (UPI 60%, Card 30%, Cash 10%)
questions.explanation: Pie chart works for proportions with few categories (3 here — perfect).

questions.scenario: Show if higher total spending correlates with more orders per customer
questions.explanation: Scatter plot shows the relationship (correlation) between two numeric variables.

hints.text: Think: am I comparing categories, showing a trend, showing proportions, or finding a relationship?
Time data → Line. Categories → Bar. Proportions → Pie. Two numbers → Scatter.

winDialogue.text: The report is PERFECT. The commissioner can see the entire fraud network at a glance. You're ready for the final boss!
The mastermind behind SHADOW42 is cornered. One final case — the boss case — to close this for good.
